scope: Sequential read-only global/Performance Schema counters around the native window, including background/observer work. String integer timers are picoseconds; absent or disabled metrics are not zero. SUM_LOCK_TIME is not a complete InnoDB row-lock timer; inspect row-lock counters separately. Maxima are cumulative and cannot be differenced. No request IDs, parameters or SQL values are captured.
